info.name: RTMS API
info.description:
The WEM-Reform API for Real-Time Market submissions available to all Market Participants.

Contact Support:
 Name: AEMO Real Time Market Submissions Team
 Email: wa.operations@aemo.com.au

item.name: API endpoint that handles searching the DSP consolidated dispatch intervals…

header.description: (Required) The id of the Initiating Participant
(Required) The id of the market

query.description: (Required) Format - date (as full-date in RFC3339). Returns the consolidated view of submissions made for the specified Trading Day (YYYY-MM-DD). The Trading Day can be in the past or in the future. Future dates are limited to the Acceptance Horizon window.
(Required) Returns the consolidated view of submissions made for the specified Facility. Facility must be a DSP Facility
(Required) This parameter must be set to 'Energy'. Returns the consolidated view of submissions made for the Energy Market Service.
